verdicts.reason: A: the logo and its tiny 'MONOGRAPH' wordmark sit on the grainy grey photo outside the white card, so the brand mark has poor contrast. The 'NOW OPEN' eyebrow now comes after the CTA and touches the 'Plan a Visit' pill, which is crammed against the bottom edge. B has the same CTA/'NOW OPEN' collision and wrong reading order, the logo is jammed against the left edge, and the wordmark is clipped to 'MONOGRAPI', which breaks the brand. That makes B slightly worse, even though its card-plus-photo split is more coherent.
